<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,5,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Hawk!
I found a glowing lizard,
so I came to report it!

<TALK 5><NAME 6><CV 3,2>Eliza!
Good of you to come. Show me.

What is it, a pitch-black lizard...
It would blend into the night...

<CHAR 5,0,5,0,8>But it glows...?
I see, this lizard glows
in dark places!

A Light Lizard, one might say.
A new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>We did it, Hunter!
A great discovery!
